categories.main_business_segments: Great Microwave Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of integrated circuit chips and microsystems. Its main products include RF transceiver chips, high-speed high-precision ADC/DAC chips, power management chips, microsystems, and modules. The company also provides technical services related to these products, primarily serving specialized fields such as data links, electronic countermeasures, wireless communication terminals, next-generation radios, phased array communications, and electronic system power supply.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs full forward design R&D technology covering the entire chain from chips to modules and systems. Core technologies include wide/narrowband signal compatible large dynamic range receiver channel design, low spurious low noise transmitter channel design, multi-chip synchronization, radiation-hardened low power transceiver design, broadband digital beamforming, and micro power module design. Manufacturing follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries while maintaining strict quality control and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily manufacturers of specialized equipment in defense and aerospace sectors, including national defense science and technology groups and research institutes. The company is a core supplier for satellite communication, especially low Earth orbit commercial satellites, digital phased array radar, data links, and electronic countermeasure systems. It also serves emerging markets like satellite internet and plans to expand into mobile communication systems and meteorological radar.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated in China, with headquarters and R&D centers located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. Its customer base is mainly domestic, including major national defense and aerospace institutions. There is no significant international sales or operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Great Microwave Technology operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless integrated circuit design company. It focuses on chip design and development, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to external foundries and subcontractors. The company also integrates microsystems and modules, providing comprehensive solutions from chip to system level.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in radiation-hardened power management chips, digital phased array systems, and microsystems integration. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 51% of revenue allocated to research activities, focusing on expanding product lines in satellite communication, digital phased array radar, and low-cost, high-reliability power solutions for aerospace applications. The strategic direction includes enhancing product coverage across the chip-module-system chain and advancing technology to international standards, especially targeting low Earth orbit satellite constellations and 6G technology readiness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated circuit products and microsystems to specialized industry customers. The company uses a direct sales model predominantly, supplemented by limited distribution sales for smaller-scale or broad-application products. Technical services related to product development and customization are also sold directly to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Texas Instruments and Analog Devices in the analog and RF chip markets. While its scale is smaller, its products have reached comparable performance levels in key metrics and hold significant domestic market share, especially in specialized defense and aerospace applications. It has established a strong first-mover advantage in China’s satellite communication and defense sectors, with many products being core or exclusive components in national projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 303 million, representing an 8.04% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 17.85 million, a 75.37% decline due to increased R&D investment and credit impairment losses. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.23 billion with stable equity. R&D expenses accounted for over 51% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment profile despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great Microwave Technology emphasizes its full forward design capability, delivering integrated solutions from chip to module to system with high integration, low power consumption, radiation hardness, and high reliability tailored for harsh environments. Its products support miniaturization and lightweight trends in satellite payloads and defense equipment, offering superior performance metrics such as dynamic range, noise suppression, and multi-channel synchronization. The company’s deep customer collaboration and customization ability create significant barriers to entry and foster long-term stable partnerships.
